description: Presidential Secretariat - Establishment of a Special Agency on Salaries and Wages in the Public Sector
reasoning: This gazette establishes a National Pay Commission and names 15 specific individuals (including Upali Wijeweera, Chandrani Senaratne, Gotabhaya Jayaratne, etc.) who are being appointed to this special agency. It also provides extensive detailed responsibilities including formulating national wage policy, reviewing remuneration structures in both public and private sectors, addressing salary anomalies, developing recruitment schemes, and making recommendations on service conditions and retirement policies. The content contains both specific people names and detailed portfolio responsibilities, making it a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3).
